purpose: Review whether a prospective Pennsylvania vendor's legal-name-aligned domain has sufficient expiration runway and has not changed too recently for automated continuation.

decision_policy.stable_domain: Unique strong Pennsylvania legal-entity match, registered aligned domain, days until expiration at/above minExpirationDays, and days since authoritative lastChanged at/above minStableDays.
decision_policy.human_review: Any failed, unavailable, uncertain, ambiguous, unregistered, misaligned, expiring-soon, recently-changed, or incomplete authoritative-date condition.

claim_boundaries: stable_domain is a continuity/timing workflow signal only
expiration runway does not guarantee renewal or uninterrupted service
lastChanged recency does not by itself establish compromise, ownership transfer, malicious activity, or fraud
legal-name/domain alignment does not prove domain ownership or control
a Pennsylvania registry match does not prove good standing, ownership, authority, creditworthiness, or legal compliance
